description: Compare two natal charts: the major aspects between person A's planets (and Ascendant) and person B's, with orbs (conjunction/opposition 6°, square/trine 5°, sextile 3°), where each person's planets fall in the other's houses, and a simple descriptive tally (not a compatibility score).

city.description: Optional shortcut: a city from the built-in offline table (about 110 large cities, English or Chinese name, e.g. "Beijing", "上海", "London", "New York"). Explicit latitude/longitude/timezone override it. For anywhere else, pass coordinates.

house_system.description: House system. Placidus (default) falls back to whole-sign inside the polar circles, where it has no solution.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in degrees, north positive

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in degrees, east positive (New York is about -74.0)

time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM. Omit if unknown: planets are then cast for local noon and there are no Ascendant, Midheaven or houses.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. "Asia/Shanghai", "America/New_York". Historical daylight saving time is applied automatically. Required unless `city` is given.
